statement:
{V} [AddCommGroup V] [LinearAlgebraGame.VectorSpace ℂ V] [LinearAlgebraGame.InnerProductSpace_v V] (u v w : V) (c : ℂ)
  (h_eq : ‖u‖ ^ 2 = ‖c • v‖ ^ 2 + ‖w‖ ^ 2) : ‖c • v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖u‖ ^ 2
name: LinearAlgebraGame.scaled_norm_le_original
content:
`scaled_norm_le_original` is a helper proof that if `‖u‖^2 = ‖c • v‖^2 + ‖w‖^2`, then
`‖c • v‖^2 ≤ ‖u‖^2`. The syntax is `scaled_norm_le_original u v w c h_eq`.
